parameters.query:
UPDATE contacts
SET email_logs = COALESCE(email_logs, '[]'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
    'id', $4::text,
    'type', 'sent',
    'subject', $1::text,
    'message', $2::text,
    'sent_at', NOW(),
    'is_read', true,
    'opened_at', NULL)
WHERE id = $3
RETURNING email_logs;

UPDATE contacts
SET email_logs = COALESCE(email_logs, '[]'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
    'id', $5::text,
    'type', 'sent',
    'subject', $1::text,
    'message', $2::text,
    'sent_at', NOW(),
    'is_read', true,
    'opened_at', NULL,
    'attachments', $3::jsonb
)::jsonb
WHERE id = $4
RETURNING email_logs;
